description: Create a new Potential Change Order (PCO).

id.description: Unique identifier for the newly created Potential Change Order. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete it.

accounting_method.description: How the change order is priced: "amount" for a lump-sum total or "unit" for quantity-times-unit-cost line items.

change_order_request_id.description: ID of the Change Order Request (COR) this PCO belongs to, on multi-tier contract configurations.

commitment_change_event_id.description: ID of the commitment Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a commitment.

contract_id.description: ID of the contract (prime or commitment) this PCO belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was created, in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Free-text description of the scope of this change order.

due_date.description: Date by which the change order is due, in ISO 8601 format.

field_change.description: True when this change order originated as a field change (a change identified in the field rather than through the office workflow).

grand_total.description: Total value of the change order including markup, as a decimal string.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

line_items.description: Line items belonging to the change order. Empty for a newly created PCO until line items are added.

line_items_extended_total.description: Sum of all line item extended amounts (after markup), as a decimal string.

line_items_total.description: Sum of all line item amounts (before markup), as a decimal string.

number.description: Human-readable change order number, unique within the contract.

origin_data.description: Free-form metadata from an external system, stored to correlate this PCO with its source record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this PCO in the external system it was imported from. Use to match records during integrations.

paid.description: True when the change order has been marked as paid.

paid_date.description: Date the change order was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

position.description: Ordering position of this PCO within its contract.

prime_change_event_id.description: ID of the prime contract Change Event this PCO was generated from. Set when the contract is a prime contract.

private.description: If true, visible to admins only; otherwise visible to those with access to the parent contract.

revision.description: Revision number of the change order, incremented on each revision.

schedule_impact_amount.description: Estimated impact of this change order on the project schedule, in days.

status.description: Workflow status of the change order.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the PCO was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

void.description: True when the change order has been voided.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field Definition (e.g. `phone_number`). Present only when the definition has an associated variant.
